onlyAcceptFromKnown: Only accept from someone you know.
turnOnLocalNetwork: Turn on Local Network for Akidev to see other phones.
cannotSeePhone: Cannot see their phone? Both phones need to be on the same Wi-Fi.
peerBusy: {name} is busy. Try again in a moment.
askThemToScan: Ask them to scan this code, or choose Share on their phone.
sourceMessage: “{title}” is read from {source}, which this phone does not have. {details} A source decides which sites this phone contacts. Add it only if you trust your friend.
addedByHand: Your friend added it by hand.
notAkidevCode: That is not an Akidev code. Ask them to show the code again.
couldNotJoinWifi: Could not join their Wi-Fi. Move the phones closer and try again.
couldNotReachPhoneWifi: Could not reach that phone. Check that both phones are on the same Wi-Fi.
couldNotReachTryAgain: Could not reach that phone. Try again.
turnWifiOnForBoth: Could not reach that phone. Turn Wi-Fi on for both phones. It does not need to be connected to a network.
noSharedWifi: That phone has no shared Wi-Fi with you. Choose “Use a temporary Wi-Fi” on this phone and ask them to scan your code.
couldNotAddSourceOffline: Could not add the source. This phone needs the internet to download it. Connect to Wi-Fi or mobile data, then add it again.
couldNotMakeCode: This phone could not make a code for it. Try again.
allowPermission: Allow {permission} for Akidev in the Android Settings app, then try again.
privateHelp: Ask them to scan this. It makes a private Wi-Fi just for this send.
cameraOff: Camera access is off. Allow it in Settings to scan a code.
cannotStartWifi: This phone could not start a temporary Wi-Fi. Use the same Wi-Fi on both phones, or turn on this phone’s hotspot and join it from the other one.
anotherPhoneShared: Another phone shared this series. It is read from the source {source}, so only a link to it is copied.
noSourceYetFrom: This phone does not have the source yet. It comes from {repo}.
noSourceYetWithSeries: This phone does not have the source yet. It comes with the series.
sourceDecides: A source decides which sites this phone contacts. Add it only if you trust your friend.
opensEpubAndCbz: Akidev opens EPUB books and CBZ comics.
fileDamaged: Check that the file is not damaged, then try opening it again.
